description: This Scala source file defines classes and objects for tracking input stream information at specific batch times within Apache Spark Streaming. It includes the StreamInputInfo case class, the StreamInputInfo companion object, and the InputInfoTracker class responsible for managing input stream metadata and statistics.

classes.name: StreamInputInfo
classes.description: A case class representing input stream information at a specific batch time, including stream ID, number of records, and metadata.

classes.name: InputInfoTracker
classes.description: A class that manages and tracks input stream data and statistics for Spark Streaming, allowing reporting, retrieval, and cleanup of input info.

methods.name: metadataDescription
methods.description: Returns an optional description string from the metadata map if present.

methods.name: reportInfo
methods.description: Records input stream information for a given batch time, throwing an exception if duplicate input stream ID is added for the same batch.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Retrieves all input stream information for a specified batch time as an immutable map.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes input stream information older than a specified batch time threshold.
